The crash was investigated for a third consecutive run (runs #23, #24, #25) with no ARQQ-specific 8-K/6-K, press release, SEC filing, or news item found dated Sept 11-16, 2026 across ir.arqit.uk, SEC/EDGAR, StockTitan, or MarketBeat. New context this run: (1) a same-day, similarly unexplained -28.4% crash in peer Horizon Quantum Holdings (HQ) suggests a sector-wide de-risking/profit-taking event rather than an ARQQ-specific catalyst, and (2) a pre-crash Seeking Alpha short thesis (Aug 25) had already flagged an imminent 5.44M-share dilution overhang as a live risk, which may have contributed to selling pressure even without a discrete dated filing surfacing in search. Score remains 2/10 (MONITORING) — no insider buying, no clean institutional accumulation signal, and a volatile/event-driven (not gradual base-building) technical setup.
watchlist.risks: Extreme single-stock volatility (-18.75% then +12.15% in two sessions) with no clear fundamental explanation for either move increases event/headline risk. Zero open-market insider buying across 6 months of Form 4 history — insiders have only exercised options, received awards, or sold. Flagged dilution overhang (5.44M shares per Seeking Alpha) remains unresolved and could pressure the stock further if an offering is priced. Analyst coverage is thin (single analyst, HC Wainwright) and the $60 price target has not been revisited since the crash, making it unreliable as a current read. Recently delisted warrants (ARQQW, Sept 3) removed a hedging/arbitrage mechanism that may have also contributed to recent volatility. Company remains pre-scale with a small float relative to trading volume spikes, amplifying moves in both directions.

news.headline: Sept 9, 2026: Record Q1 FY2027 results — revenue of $480.5 million (up 6% YoY, vs. $456.1M consensus), adjusted diluted EPS of $0.59 (up 84% YoY, vs. $0.25 consensus), bookings of $683 million (up 71% YoY), book-to-bill ratio of 1.4, and a record funded backlog of $1.5 billion (up 37% YoY, up 23% sequentially) — shares rose over 10% on the print.

Sept 2, 2026: AV awarded a landmark ~$464.8 million U.S. Army contract for the Enduring-High Energy Laser (E-HEL) program, the first-ever production contract for a high-energy laser weapons system in U.S. history, anchored by AV's LOCUST laser family.
Sept 4, 2026: FDA approval of Guardant360 CDx as a companion diagnostic for AstraZeneca's camizestrant in advanced breast cancer.
Sept 9, 2026: Guardant Health and collaborators to present 20 abstracts at the 2026 World Conference on Lung Cancer.
Aug 24, 2026: PDUFA target action date for the Deramiocel BLA extended to Nov 22, 2026, following submission of additional Phase 3 HOPE-3 data.
Sept 14, 2026: B. Riley Securities upgrade (Neutral to Buy, PT $5 to $21) tied to the deramiocel FDA path, driving a spike to $8.81 before settling back to $8.56.

Sept 10, 2026: Syntec Optics announced $5 million in additional recurring defense orders, more than doubling its cumulative purchase orders to over $9 million versus its Q1 announcement, spanning missile-guidance optics, night-vision and target-detection optics, targeting lasers, and AR/MR headset optics.
Aug 26, 2026: Company announced a new recurring space satellite waveguide order, continuing its diversification into the space economy alongside defense.
Sept 3, 2026: Unusual Machines announced a partnership with Altana to strengthen supply chain intelligence and traceability across its drone components manufacturing.

Sept 8, 2026: UMAC disclosed participation in eight upcoming investor conferences, including CEO Allan Evans's fireside chat at the Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference on Sept 15 — a scheduled investor-relations event rather than a new operational catalyst.
Q2 2026 earnings beat reported Aug 6, 2026 — stock jumped 9.8% on the print per Investing.com's earnings call transcript coverage
Engaged with the space-industry community at the Space Defense & Security Summit in Paris, Sept 10, 2026 (still the latest newsroom item as of this run)
Sept 8, 2026: CEO Benjamin Wolff's open-market share purchase (~$99,131) remains the standout recent insider-conviction signal, unchanged from prior checks.

Sept 9, 2026: Palladyne AI presented at the Jefferies Global Industrials Conference 2026, with management framing continued "growth builds" in its AI/robotics platform business — a scheduled investor event rather than a new operational disclosure.

Aug 12, 2026: Positive topline Phase 2a results for intranasal NEO100 — met primary endpoint with 48.9% six-month progression-free survival vs. a 20% standard-of-care benchmark (p=0.0047); median overall survival 26.09 months (single-arm, open-label, 24-patient study; not powered as confirmatory, no randomized control arm).
Sept 9, 2026: Announced pricing of a $15 million registered direct offering.

Sept 15, 2026: Press release confirming Treace will showcase multiple new product innovations (Lapiplasty Lightning System, Tailorplasty MIS Tailor's Bunion System, Treace X-ray App, SuperBite compression screws, HyperPlate XM implant) and present five-year clinical data at the AOFAS Annual Meeting in Seattle, Sept 16-19, 2026.

Sept 16, 2026 (pre-market check, per task's specific AOFAS instruction): Searched directly for AOFAS Day 1 product/clinical data announcements. Found only the same Sept 15 pre-announcement (new bunion tools and five-year study results to be shown in Seattle) — no additional discrete new data readout or product announcement has been issued yet as the conference opens today; nothing beyond what was already captured in the prior run.
16th Electron launch of 2026 successfully completed Sept 11, 2026, continuing Rocket Lab's high launch cadence
Rocket Lab launched a germanium-free space solar cell (reported Sept 9, 2026), a minor positive technology/product news item
Signed a contract with SSC Space for two Alpha launches from Esrange Space Center, Sweden (announced Sept 9, 2026) — still the latest newsroom item as of this run
Berenberg published commentary examining the Sweden/SSC Space contract (Sept 10, 2026)
BlueBird satellite constellation buildout continuing, though the 45-satellite target has slipped to early 2027 per Q2 2026 earnings guidance (reported ~Aug 2026)
AT&T/T-Mobile/Verizon joint-venture direct-to-device partnership chatter (from a proposed JV announcement referenced in coverage of AST's satellite plans)
Mid-August 2026 Phase 3 LUCIDITY topline data for avexitide in post-bariatric hypoglycemia drove the stock from the low $20s to the high $30s (Aug 18-20 gap up on ~24M and ~8M share volume days).
Follow-on capital raise completed in the wake of the LUCIDITY readout.

July 20, 2026: Tempus AI to acquire cancer test maker Personalis for $1.5B (this is NOT a new catalyst despite recirculating in Sept 15-16 news aggregation — confirmed dated July 20, 2026, well before this run's window).
Sept 1, 2026: Piper Sandler upgrade (Neutral to Overweight, PT $56 to $76) — already on record from prior runs.

Sept 10, 2026: FDA imposed a partial clinical hold pausing new-patient enrollment in BHV-7000 epilepsy trials after rodent findings flagged a metabolite of concern — shares fell more than 15% intraday.
Sept 10-14, 2026: Multiple securities-investigation notices filed by plaintiffs' firms (SueWallSt, Levi & Korsinsky) related to the FDA hold disclosure.

FERC Docket EL26-101-000 (Oklo's emergency complaint vs. PJM Interconnection over withdrawal of a 750 MW mixed-technology project from Cycle 01) remains open with no Commission ruling as of this pre-market Sept 16 check — this is now the 5th consecutive check with a stalled docket and no FERC action (pre-market/after-close Sept 14, pre-market/after-close Sept 15, and this pre-market Sept 16 check). A direct check of FERC's public pending-complaints listing and multiple targeted web searches again found no Commission order, ruling, or news release. PJM's Sept 4 answer asking the Commission to deny the complaint remains the latest substantive filing in the docket. Per playbook rules, a 5th consecutive stall is grounds for demotion consideration but is not automatic — given OKLO is already at the low end of MONITORING (2.5/10) with the docket outcome only one of several inputs to the score, and no adverse ruling has actually occurred (this is a non-event, not a negative development), this run holds the score rather than demoting further; continued stalls will be reassessed each run.

Sept 11, 2026: Oklo launched a new at-the-market equity offering program for up to $1 billion of Class A common stock (replacing a prior program that had already raised ~$1 billion via 17,971,448 shares sold), triggering a single-day decline of more than 7% on dilution concerns. This was independently verified via SEC EDGAR in run #24 and remains correctly reflected; no genuinely new information on this offering has emerged since then.

Sept 3, 2026: Public warrants (ARQQW) expired and were delisted from Nasdaq per company notice (StockTitan / GlobeNewswire, https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ARQQW/6-k-arqit-quantum-inc-current-report-foreign-issuer-9d6eb98bf67a.html)
